description.value: RV-only park (no tent or car camping) on an agri-tourism farm in East Kelowna, a 5-minute walk from Mission Creek Greenway and minutes from Myra Canyon's historic KVR trestles; cycle tourers cannot stay here as tenting is explicitly prohibited.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website clearly establishes this as an RV-only park ('8 spacious pull-through RV sites, NO TENTING or CAR CAMPING'), which is a critical factor for a cycling tourism directory. The site confirms water and laundry facilities, nearby food options, and a booking/reservation system. The location adjacent to Myra Canyon and the Kettle Valley Railway trestle trail is highly relevant to cycling tourism, but the absence of tent or hiker/biker sites limits utility for self-propelled touring cyclists.
concerns: RV-only facility — website explicitly prohibits tenting and car camping, making this unsuitable for the typical self-propelled touring cyclist
OSM community tag is 'Myra Canyon' but the business is in East Kelowna; the Myra Canyon attribution is directionally accurate but may confuse users
Website amenity text is truncated ('Washroom and Laundry Facil...'), preventing full confirmation of facility details
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The park's RV-only policy (no tenting or hiker/biker sites) means it cannot accommodate self-propelled touring cyclists; however, its direct proximity to Myra Canyon and the KVR trestle trail makes it potentially relevant for cyclists touring with support vehicles. WWC program managers should determine whether RV-only properties qualify.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Local Attractions page references 'Myra Canyon Bike Rentals & Tours' and the Kettle Valley Railway prominently, indicating the operators are cycling-aware. The farm also notes it is a supplier to 'There & Back Again Farms', suggesting local food connections.
